definition_notes: Single anecdote: one complex code migration by agents + engineers vs engineers alone a year earlier. Not an org-wide rate.
evidence: Pichai: "a particularly complex code migration done by agents and engineers working together was completed six times faster than was possible a year ago with engineers alone."

definition_notes: Within-engineer efficiency effect: PRs completed in highest Copilot-usage weeks vs zero-usage weeks, holding measured coding/browser time constant. Observational; 16,223 IC engineers in Microsoft Cloud+AI over 43 weeks. arXiv preprint by Microsoft authors (not peer-reviewed).
evidence: Abstract: "Engineers are estimated to complete 40.5% more PRs in their highest GHCP usage weeks relative to their zero-usage weeks, holding measured development effort constant."

definition_notes: Controlled experiment with recruited developers (not Microsoft employees) implementing an HTTP server in JavaScript; single task. Authors from Microsoft Research, GitHub and MIT Sloan.
evidence: Abstract: "The treatment group, with access to the AI pair programmer, completed the task 55.8% faster than the control group."

definition_notes: Same experiment as arXiv:2302.06590: 95 professional developers randomly split; Copilot group 1h11m vs 2h41m; P=.0017; 95% CI [21%, 89%].
evidence: GitHub blog: "developers who used GitHub Copilot completed the task significantly faster–55% faster than the developers who didn't use GitHub Copilot."

definition_notes: Range 20%-30% stated on stage by CEO Satya Nadella at LlamaCon; value is midpoint. Known only via media report of the conversation.
